tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get the current Predbat battery plan. 'rows' is a markdown table of half-hourly slots with a 'units' legend describing its columns; an empty cell means that field is not set for that slot.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get the current Predbat system status and configuration

tools.name: get_apps
tools.description: Get predbat apps.yaml static configuration data, with credentials redacted by default

filter.description: The configuration item name to filter on, as a Python regex (optional)

masked.description: Redact credential-like values such as API keys, secrets and passwords (default true)

tools.name: get_apps_config
tools.description: Get the current value of one apps.yaml key, with a credential-like value redacted. Use before set_apps_config to read the value you are about to change. Accepts the same dotted paths set_apps_config writes, so you can read back exactly what you wrote.

key.description: The apps.yaml key to read. Use a dotted path to reach inside a nested structure, e.g. 'forecast_solar[0].azimuth'. Call get_apps first, or read the parent key, to see what the structure contains. If a path does not exist the error lists the keys that do.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Get Predbat's internal state variables - the same data a debug yaml carries, one key at a time. Called with no arguments it returns every small variable and describes the large ones (per-minute series) without returning them.

keys.description: Specific state variable names to return (optional - omit for every small variable)

filter.description: Only return variables whose name matches this Python regex (optional)

max_bytes.description: Per-variable size budget before it is described rather than returned (default 2048, maximum 262144)

tools.name: get_log
tools.description: Get the Predbat log (predbat.log), filtered by level, search term, regex and time window - use this to diagnose warnings and errors. Lines are returned oldest-first. Very long lines are cut to keep the response small; read one back in full with 'line_number'.

filter.description: Log level to return: all, info, warnings or errors (default warnings)

search.description: Only return lines containing this text, case-insensitive (optional)

pattern.description: Only return lines matching this Python regular expression, case-insensitive (optional). Combined with 'search' and 'filter' rather than replacing them

hours.description: Only return lines written in the last N hours (optional)

start.description: Only return lines at or after this point: a date (2026-08-28), a time today (17:00 or 17:00:30) or both (2026-08-28 17:00). Combined with 'hours' if both are given, narrower wins (optional)

end.description: Only return lines at or before this point, same formats as 'start'. A bare date covers the whole of that day (optional)

line_number.description: Return this one line in full, ignoring every other filter (optional). Use it to read back a line the response cut short - a truncated line names its own number in the marker it carries

context.description: With 'line_number', also return this many lines either side (default 0, maximum 50)

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. The most recent matching lines are the ones kept, but they are returned oldest-first (default 200, maximum 5000)

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Get the current Predbat live configuration settings

filter.description: The entity ID name to filter on, as a Python regex (optional)
The configuration item name to filter on, as a Python regex (optional)

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Set Predbat live configuration setting (not for apps.yaml)

entity_id.description: The entity ID of the configuration setting to update

value.description: The new value for the configuration setting

tools.name: set_plan_override
tools.description: Override the current Predbat plan for a specific 30 minute period with a manual action

action.description: The action to perform: demand, charge, export, freeze_charge, freeze_export, clear

time.description: The time at which to perform the action, in "Day HH:MM" format (24-hour), covers one 30-minute period

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search every Home Assistant entity id with a regular expression - not just Predbat's own. Requires switch.predbat_ai_ha_state_enable.

pattern.description: Python regular expression matched against entity ids

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 50, maximum 200)

tools.name: get_entity_state
tools.description: Get one Home Assistant entity's current state - not just Predbat's own. Requires switch.predbat_ai_ha_state_enable.

entity_id.description: The entity id to look up, e.g. binary_sensor.front_door

attributes.description: Include the entity's attribute dict as well as its state (default false) - kept separate from search_entities because attribute dicts are bulky

tools.name: get_entity_history
tools.description: Get one Home Assistant entity's history over a time window, bucketed into fixed-width time slots - not just Predbat's own. Requires switch.predbat_ai_ha_state_enable.

entity_id.description: The entity id to fetch history for

start.description: Start of the window, an ISO-8601 timestamp (assumed UTC if it carries no offset). Clamped to at most 30 days before 'end'

end.description: End of the window, an ISO-8601 timestamp (assumed UTC if it carries no offset)

bucket_minutes.description: Width of each bucket in minutes (default 30). The window is pulled in, not the bucket width, if this would exceed 500 buckets

attribute.description: Bucket this attribute's value instead of the entity's state (optional - defaults to the entity's state)
